selection_data: VisA normal-training development partitions only; deterministic DTD synthetic positives
recipes: One deterministic rectangle per positive, log-uniform aspect ratio 0.5..2; area fraction fixed by scale; DTD source rotated by a multiple of 90 degrees; recipe RNG seeded by model seed, category and image content hash
dtd_selection: sorted data/dtd/images/*/*.jpg; recipe-derived index; source hash recorded before rendering
screen: All 11 configurations in first registered seed on all 12 VisA categories; retain the best AUPRO configuration in each family with stable name as tie break
confirmation: Confirm those three fixed family winners using both remaining seeds; no replacement using confirmation or real-test scores
selection_metric: AUPRO@0.30; compare fixed macro means across categories and registered seeds
stopping: Reject unsupported families, retain negative results, never choose a real-test winner. No automatic Q3 success claim.
scope: Synthetic development selects hypotheses; it does not demonstrate effectiveness on real defects or method novelty.
